programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S2
programme.desc: The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa's amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: the Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world's 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature's best lumberjacks.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Volcanic Odysseys S1
programme.desc: For volcanologist Tom Pfeiffer, any volcanic activity that happens in Indonesia is of interest due to its location of the largest eruption in modern history--Krakatoa.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: During recess, See Mi Nau’s brother, See Yew Soon, visits her and brings her food. He pesters her about school and studies, in school. James Blond notices this and asks her about it. She tells him about her brother and that he’s always montoring her activities and becomes too controlling. James Blond tells her that she needs to talk to him. See Mi Nau tells him that she finds it difficult to articulate her feelings. He teaches her about metaphors and analogies, how they help conveying messages clearer. She follows his advice talks to See Yew Soon and finally gets through to him.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin are stuck in the limbo, along with many other parents. While they questions their past parenting choices, the kids and Beta work together to get into the limbo to save the parent. It’s a success, but along the way, they lose one very important person.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: A family of strict parents and siblings who don’t get along with each other. After an argument at the dinner table, Sky and Ramunah coop up in their rooms to rant about their parents with their friends. Right there and then, they discover a video game that can take their problems away.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah discover that they can really control their parents. They call their best friends over to plan an unforgettable weekend together. They finally get to do the things that their parents never allowed. Now, they can go all out and have the best time of their life.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: Sky and Ramunah received a message from a mysterious person whose name is beta about how they can save their parents. Before taking on the mission, the kids trains for it and they reflect on how they have been treating their parents, as well as questioning if their newfound freedom is more important than saving their parents.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The English teacher’s method is too strict and ineffective. She has poor grasp of the language and very unqualified. She teaches the class the wrong pronunciations. Cikgu Joji the BM teacher replaces her and becomes the English and BM teacher. She can’t handle the workload and stress, and she mixes up the two subjects in one class. Encik Yusof, the Assistant Principal, brings in a new English teacher to the class…

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. He turns to Cikgu Joji for advice. Cikgu Joji teaches him to be firm and tough on them (and also explore the differences of British and Malaysian schools). James Blond becomes too tough, punishing the kids for small mischiefs and mistakes. In the end, Cikgu Joji makes him realize of his errors. He apologizes to the students. Even though what he did was wrong, he now has the respect and fear of the students and he can control them better.

programme.title: No Gadget No Problem
programme.desc: Dunia di mana keseronokan dan kreativiti tidak terikat pada skrin. Mengajak kanak-kanak untuk meneroka, bermain, dan menemui kegembiraan dalam aktiviti tanpa penggunaan peranti elektronik.

programme.title: Take CTRL
programme.desc: The weekend ends, and Puan Sheila and Encik Jalaluddin goes back to normal mode. They start to sense something suspicious about Sky and Ramunah’s behaviour. They discover that they have been controlled by their children and they try to confront them. Out of panic, the children switch them to game mode. The game then goes haywire and the parents are stuck permanently in game mode. Sky and Ramunah call their friends over to help them undo what they have done.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: Introduction of the new teacher, James Blond. The students introduce themselves in terrible English, and prove to be a whole new challenge for James Blond.

programme.title: Oh My English! Level Up
programme.desc: The students, who are now familiar with the nice and soft-spoken Mr. James Blond, take advantage of that. James Blond has trouble controlling the class. programme.title: Basilicata
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: OPA!
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: Cheese with Every Meal!
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: Classic Greek Recipes
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: Spring Inspiration
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: LIVEFEED Bluesfest
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons.nnCustomers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service.nnThe owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others.nnWorking with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through.nnThe Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.title: Sweet Kisses
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: Wow Factor
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever!

programme.title: Twists on the Classics
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Big Wow Desserts
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen!

programme.title: Peter Five Eight
programme.desc: Sam, a seemingly poised and glamorous real estate agent in a small mountain community is revealed to be an unhinged and troubled alcoholic with a dark secret, when a charismatic man in a black sedan named Peter shows up in town one day.

programme.title: High Voltage [Extended Version]
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: A somewhat mentally handicapped 20-year-old man works as a laborer, but everyone abuses his naivety. A nice 40-year-old American woman hires him one day and they become close. However, the town and his family see her as predatory.

programme.title: No One Lives
programme.desc: A gang of ruthless highway killers kidnap a wealthy couple traveling cross country only to shockingly discover that things are not what they seem.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Juvenile
programme.desc: Troublemaker Billy Forsetti falls for the beautiful Jennifer. But when a carjacking takes a turn for the worse, Billy finds himself in for trouble.

programme.title: The Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: What You Wish For
programme.desc: A down-on-his-luck chef with gambling problems flees to a Latin American villa to join a team of chefs who cook for the super rich. He soon gets more than he bargained for when he discovers the dark secrets of his employer's unique and dangerous culinary appetite

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Hospitality
programme.desc: A woman with a checkered past must protect her son when a man brings trouble to her isolated bed and breakfast.

programme.title: Chosen Family
programme.desc: Ann (Heather Graham) is a yoga teacher struggling to achieve inner peace despite the fact her family is driving her crazy and her dating life is miserable.

programme.title: The Coca Cola Kid
programme.desc: A smug sales executive treks to Australia to improve regional sales and becomes embroiled in sexual and professional shenanigans.

programme.title: The Competition
programme.desc: Mauldin (Thora Birch) is a strong-willed but misguided young woman who encourages her millions of blog followers to apply her scientific formula to all relationships in order to prevent heartache.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: A South African gold mine foreman is unwittingly manipulated by an unscrupulous gang of financiers who want to flood the mine to raise the price of gold on the world market.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor's life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away from it all in a remote country house but when a mysterious injured man turns up on their doorstep telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Broken Star [Extended Version]
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.desc: A third-rate British spy is sent to an island, unaware he is there to lure Soviet spies.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: A deputized gunslinger takes up the call to hunt down the last Cowboy the chase is on and the bullets fly and only one of these hardened men can survive.

programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Clean

programme.title: The Cooler

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf

programme.title: Hideout

programme.desc: Upper body strength is often overlooked by riders, but it's essential for jockeys. Sean demonstrates some quick and easy exercises to build upper body strength.

programme.title: Jockey Fit: Everyday Strength
programme.desc: On our third day of training, we’ll focus on general strength exercises to support your cycling performance.

programme.title: Jockey Fit: Reset & Recover
programme.desc: The last day of the week is for rest and recovery, but that doesn’t mean complete inactivity. Sean highlights the importance of a quieter, restful day and explains why stretching is essential for effective recovery before starting a new week.

programme.title: Jockey Fit: Hip Mobility and Flexors
programme.desc: Good hip mobility is essential for every discipline, and Sean demonstrates his top exercises to maintain it.

programme.title: National Racehorse Week with Tom Ellis
programme.desc: Tom Ellis Racing welcomes visitors for National Racehorse Week 2026. Get up close to the stunning racehorses, meet the dedicated stable staff, and discover the daily routines that keep the yard running smoothly.

programme.title: Faultless: Hickstead, UK
programme.desc: British riders Matthew Sampson and Jessica Mendoza compete at Hickstead, a venue renowned for its old-world charm. Both are aiming to secure an invitation to the Spruce Meadows Masters, where they hope to contend for the five-million-dollar grand prize.

programme.title: Jockey Fit: Leg Day for Riders
programme.desc: A rider favourite—leg day! Essential for all riders to build leg stability. Sean guides you to improve your leg strength.

programme.title: LGCT 2026: Shanghai
programme.desc: The Asian leg takes place at the cutting-edge Shanghai Juss International Equestrian Centre, where advanced engineering meets elite equestrian sport. Riders tackle challenging courses in China’s premier equestrian stadium, showcasing skill and precision.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E056
programme.desc: Nicolas has already left in search of his uncle when Florencia is visited by Moncho, who asks for a chance to earn her love, but their conversation is interrupted by Hilario's arrival. Jack hides his satisfaction in front of Victoria when she assures him that she doesn't care where and with whom Nicolas spent the night, as everything between them is still impossible. Given that Leopoldo’s body hasn’t appeared, Hilario decides to go to the city to tell Fernanda that Federico accidentally shot her father; her reaction causes her to faint. Eugenia, worried because she senses that something bad is happening, leaves a message for Leopoldo on his phone telling him how much she loves him. Nicolas is discouraged because he hasn’t found Leopoldo, but Florencia encourages him to keep the faith that he will find him. Federico gets scared when Moncho and another henchman want to forcibly remove him from the room where he is staying.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E32
programme.desc: Carlos Raúl y César han llegado a casa de los Palacios. A punto de llorar, el gordo toma a la pequeña entre sus brazos.

programme.title: Te Tengo en Salsa - S01:E33
programme.desc: Luego de contarle a Francesca la noticia de que Tatianita es hija del gordo, Ninoska se marcha a casa de los Perroni.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E038 - Episode 38
programme.desc: Cheito sufre como nadie al saber la muerte de Mariana. Abigail quiere que la memoria de su hija esté siempre viva. Álvaro lee una carta de Rosalba en la que encuentra una verdad que lo horroriza.

programme.title: Abigail - S04:E039 - Episode 39
programme.desc: Guillermo se niega a llevar a cabo el plan que tiene Rosalba y deciden terminar su relación. María Begoña le ofrece dinero a Carlota para que desaparezca. Cheito le pide a Carlota que devuelva el dinero pues él no piensa huir a ninguna parte.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E50
programme.desc: Alfonso advierte que es posible que Lorena conozca a los autores intelectuales del asesinato de Marco Aurelio, y que su vida podría estar en peligro- Lorena va con Magda al anticuario a prometerle a Pedro que ellas nunca dirán nada de lo que saben, para que les perdone la vida; pero para su sorpresa Omar se presenta en la tienda y las descubre.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E50
programme.desc: Alfonso advierte que es posible que Lorena conozca a los autores intelectuales del asesinato de Marco Aurelio, y que su vida podría estar en peligro- Lorena va con Magda al anticuario a prometerle a Pedro que ellas nunca dirán nada de lo que saben, para que les perdone la vida; pero para su sorpresa Omar se presenta en la tienda y las descubre.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E03 - The Journey
programme.desc: The trek from earth to Mars is fraught with difficulties, from surviving radiation en route to landing in a space craft not yet designed. Mars One founder Bas Lansdorp attends the Mars Society Convention in Washington, DC, to debate the risks and rewards with scientists from around the world.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E04 - Surviving on Mars
programme.desc: From a greenhouse in Holland to a desert landscape in Iceland, scientists are using the earth to tests ways to keep a Mars settlement alive and well. It's the ultimate survival challenge, requiring major innovations to find water, grow food and clean the air.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E05 - Why One Way
programme.desc: Mars One plans one-way missions to Mars; the goal is not simply to explore, but to colonize the red planet. A one-way trip saves billions and eliminates the risk of a return voyage. But can the crew survive in such utter isolation? Some candidates for the mission reflect on this challenge.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E06 - The Ice Giants
programme.desc: Beyond the asteroid belt lay the ice giants, some can be seen with the naked eye, others only glimpsed once by a passing probe. We are again sending cameras to the edge of the solar system giving us The New insights into the evolution of our worlds.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E07 - The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: These are the the Moon's of the gas giants. Each a unique and mysterious world of its own. Some have oceans of water, geysers of Sulphur or atmospheres of plastic. Some are just now being seen at the outer rim of our solar system, all are worthy of much more scrutiny.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E08 - The Sun
programme.desc: It powers the machinery of nature; our weather, encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. When it sets in the West it reveals to us its many billions of sibling stars populating the night sky. We study our Sun closely, and like a Rosetta stone it can reveal the secrets of all the other stars above.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E09 - Exo Planets
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S01:E10 - Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E01 - Astronauts
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E94 - Artemis II Ready for the Moon
programme.desc: Explore the rockets, landers, vehicles, and space capsule paving the way for future Artemis missions to the lunar surface. And meet the engineers—and the machines—behind NASA's Commercial Lander Payload Services (CLPS) missions, which are revolutionizing humanity’s relationship with the Moon.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E68 - ICARUS Tracking Creatures From Space
programme.desc: The ICARUS system monitors the movements and behaviors of Earth’s creatures from space.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E49 - Flight of the Dragon Mission Update
programme.desc: Witness this historic flight, from the first manned launch from the US in nearly a decade to the first splashdown attempt since the Apollo era.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E72 - Capturing A Black Hole In Our Milky Way
programme.desc: Astronomers linked radio dishes around the world to create the "Event Horizon Telescope" and have utilized this tool to photograph a supermassive black hole in the heart of our own Milky Way Galaxy. Its name is "Sagittarius A Prime" and it is over 4 million times more massive than the Sun.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E70 - Building The James Webb Telescope
programme.desc: This is the epic story of the James Webb Space Telescope, told first-hand by the scientists who developed it. Building the largest, most advanced, and most expensive telescope ever made does not come without its challenges. But seeing further into space than ever before will be worth the struggle.

programme.title: Destination Mars - S01:E01 - The Mission
programme.desc: The United States and China are considering launching manned missions to Mars -- in 25 years. But Netherlands-based Mars One has a bold plan to land humans on Mars in 2027. Is the mission fueled by wishful thinking and unproven science -- or will private exploration get us there?

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E03 - Operation Yellowstone
programme.desc: In Region 5, wardens ride a jet boat up the Yellowstone River, keeping an eye on fly fishing guides and stumbling upon a boat mishap. After that, they head to Region 1 for some shooting practice.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E04 - Operation Antelope Dummy
programme.desc: With the number of Pronghorn antelopes dropping, the Wardens in Region 7 set up a decoy sting right before the season kicks off, but the major issue turns out to be people trespassing on opening day. Meanwhile, Region 4 Warden Bryan Golie gets a call about a possible poaching incident.

programme.desc: While solo climbing Mt. Goddard, a remote peak in the California Sierra, Gregg Hein's leg is crushed by a boulder and he's sent careening down the mountain. Barely able to stop his fall, he's now faced with a horrific compound fracture.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E06 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 2
programme.desc: After his leg is crushed by a boulder, Gregg Hein is stranded on a high Sierra peak with an infected compound fracture. Knowing he won't be reported missing for days, Gregg attempts to crawl off the mountain and rescue himself.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E13 - Hunt and Capture Saddam Hussein
programme.desc: Ten years ago, thousands of US and Coalition forces personnel, ranging from elite soldiers to reservists, found themselves in the middle of two conflicts that required an entirely different approach to warfare than they had previously experienced. From special forces units securing vital points of strategic interest and capturing key individuals in Afghanistan. This episode of CQB takes a close look at how special operations were integrated into regular units and how they fought through many close quarter combat situations with a combination of intelligence, high-tech weaponry and surveillance technologies to find and capture Saddam Hussein.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E01 - Terry's Criminal Mind
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink. We test fire multiple handguns underwater to see if you can actually penetrate a car windshield and save the victim.

programme.desc: The Upper Missouri River is a top spot for trout fishing and rafting. In Region 4's Cascade district, there's a buzz around a strange camper on private property. In Region 7, they're busy doing water safety inspections.

programme.desc: Wardens in Region 2 are checking out a Tip Mont report about several elk down in an area known for grizzlies. When they get there, one elk and the suspect aren't around. Meanwhile, wardens in Region 7 are dealing with gunfire during a decoy sting operation.

programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.desc: Wardens in Region 2 are checking out a Tip Mont report about several elk down in an area known for grizzlies. When they get there, one elk and the suspect aren't around. Meanwhile, wardens in Region 7 are dealing with gunfire during a decoy sting operation.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E07 - Iraqi Sniper Attack
programme.desc: On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corp Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harms way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E08 - Lightning Strike
programme.desc: A bass fishing trip goes horribly wrong when a bolt of lightning strikes their boat, leaving Seventeen-year-old Christian Neal burned and unconscious and his father Gabe blown into the water and paralyzed. It will take a miracle to save them.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E02 - Shark Go Boom!
programme.desc: In Jaws, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a giant shark on a motorized platform to test if you can hit, and explode, the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S10:E04 - Shepton Mallet Part 1
programme.desc: Karl & Stuart enter HMP Shepton Mallet. Part 1: Stuart faces paranormal activity in a cell block, sensing something that seeks his attention.

programme.title: Most Haunted Unseen - S10:E05 - Shepton Mallet Part 2
programme.desc: Karl wanders through the corridors of this very haunted prison alone. Visiting the death cell, execution room, and cell block, where something gets a little too close.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: From a regular student to a royal girlfriend, Kate Middleton has transformed into a real-life princess. In less than ten years, this everyday girl with a normal background captured her prince's heart and is now on track to become the future Queen of England.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E09 - Queen Camilla
programme.desc: The documentary Queen Camilla? takes a closer look at Camilla Parker-Bowles, covering her history, her life, and what lies ahead. It focuses on her long standing ties with Prince Charles. The film also delves into the drama around Camilla's role in Prince Charles's marriage to Princess Diana.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E12 - The New Royals
programme.desc: Princesses Beatrice and Eugenie have gone through a lot of media attention and tough situations in their lives. From their parents' very public split to being targeted by the press, they've been through quite a bit. Despite all this, they remain dedicated to supporting the monarchy with their charity work. Through serving the Commonwealth, both sisters continue to make a positive impact.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E51 - Return of the Wolves
programme.desc: Capture teams from the U.S. National Park Service track down and relocate wolves to Isle Royale National Park in Lake Superior under an ambitious initiative to restore balance to a wilderness ecosystem.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E59 - Saving the Right Whale
programme.desc: The North Atlantic Right Whale is on the verge of extinction. The leading cause of death and injury to the whales is from ship strikes or entanglement in fishing lines. In this Breakthrough episode, we will hear from the leading experts and biologists who are racing to save this species.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E01 - Sinking Cities
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. In this episode, travel with scientists from the Earth Observatory of Singapore across the region to understand what is causing cities to sink, how they are being monitored, and why building resilience into communities is critical to their long-term survival.

programme.title: Changing Ocean Asia - S01:E02 - Extreme Weather, Powerful Tsunamis
programme.desc: Across south-east Asia there are mega cities sinking fast. The race is on to predict how fast cities will sink. For scientists at the Earth Observatory of Singapore, it is a race against time to understand the effects climate change will have on coastal infrastructures in the region, ports, and trade. Just how prepared are we, for extreme weather events in the future?

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E01 - Part One
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we explore the USS Arizona and the marine environment which formed around it. Later, we journey into the underwater world of Yellowstone National Park.

programme.title: Underwater Wonders - S01:E02 - Part Two
programme.desc: The US National Parks have some of the most iconic landscapes in the U.S. But there is also an underwater side to explore! Today we dive into the cave systems of Death Valley National Park, journey to Montezuma Well, search for shipwrecks in Buck Island, and explore Lake Mead.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E09 - Bighorn Range
programme.desc: Bighorn sheep are captured and translocated in the mountains of Nevada.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E10 - Preserving A Predator
programme.desc: Conservationists capture and translocate lions across Africa to replenish a once-extinct population.

programme.desc: Working to protect our treasured natural resources in some of the country's most secluded spots means there's never a boring day on the job.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E05 - Saddle Sores
programme.desc: The guys are feeling great as they leave sheep territory, but the 22-hour trip to Tom-Tom, the first moose camp, feels endless. It'll take them two long days of riding to get there. As they head into moose land with a successful sheep packed up high, trouble always seems just around the corner on their journey. After riding for eight hours, issues start cropping up.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E09 - Operation Mac Pass
programme.desc: In this episode, the Wardens get a Tip-Mont call about some elk that were taken illegally and go after the suspects.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E10 - Operation Paddlefish
programme.desc: This week, our Wardens are out in Montana keeping an eye on the rivers as folks go paddlefishing, and we're also trying to get rid of a troublesome bear from someone's property.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E03 - Glacier Gold
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his son Kael are underneath a huge glacier, metal detecting for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E04 - The Ghosts of Pine Log
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia are re-tracing old footsteps by paying a visit to the old Pine Log property in California.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Predator (1987). Additionally, for one of our larger tests - can you actually chop down a jungle forest with a Minigun? Actor Bill Duke - who co-starred with Arnold Schwarzenegger for the film and who's character performed this weapon stunt - joins us to find out. But first, we have to build a jungle.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E07 - Scoreless
programme.desc: Using a unique method to crack a safe, Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) uses a blowtorch to cut through a safe, fill it with water, and blow the door off using a small explosive device. We test this, along with the effects of a 20mm antitank rifle on a safe from the movie Thuderbolt and Lightfoot.

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, was incredibly enchanting and unforgettable, leaving a lasting impact like no other woman of her era. Known as a fairy-tale princess, a loving wife, a dedicated mother, and a style icon, this documentary digs deeper to uncover the true person behind the endless spotlight.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: Despite all the media buzz, much of it not exactly flattering, Harry remains a bit of an enigma. This engaging documentary offers fresh insights and footage to shed light on a royal prince who has dealt with both heartache and scandals.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E03 - Glacier Gold
programme.desc: This week on Gold Fever join Tom and his son Kael are underneath a huge glacier, metal detecting for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E04 - Hodroyd Hall Part 1
programme.desc: An all but deserted manor house that boasts murder, death and intrigue among its history becomes the setting for one of the most intriguing investigation to date. The team are showered with object that appear to land in the same way.

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E05 - Hodroyd Hall Part 2
programme.desc: Yvette and team are put to the test as activity seems to be all around them, something is following them but who or what? Could it be the spirit of a man they connect who died near the house over 100 years ago?

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E06 - Hodroyd Hall Part 3
programme.desc: Yvette and team are put to the test as activity seems to be all around them, something is following them but who or what? Could it be the spirit of a man they connect who died near the house over 100 years ago?

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E07 - Kelham Hall Part 1
programme.desc: From the start, there is activity prevalent in this historical building. Glen is faced with something unexplained early on, Gregg is faced with his most demanding vigil yet and the rest of team chase a sinister shadow that lurks in the dark corridor

programme.title: Most Haunted - S24:E04 - Hodroyd Hall Part 1
programme.desc: An all but deserted manor house that boasts murder, death and intrigue among its history becomes the setting for one of the most intriguing investigation to date. The team are showered with object that appear to land in the same way.

programme.title: Wardens - S01:E09 - Operation Mac Pass
programme.desc: In this episode, the Wardens get a Tip-Mont call about some elk that were taken illegally and go after the suspects.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E01 - The Secret Lives of Tigers
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Siberian tigers are the largest of all cats. In historic times, the tiger's range was vast, covering much of Asia. Over the last century, they've experienced an almost total population crash, and at least 97% of those tigers have gone.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E02 - The Secret Lives of Snow Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Often referred to as the gray ghost or ghost of the mountains, this animal's rarity and elusiveness was legendary. In the past, it was known as the ounce, but today we've settled on the name snow leopard.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E03 - The Secret Lives of Pumas
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Pumas are also known by the names of cougar or mountain lion. However, these cats are only distantly related to lions. They're much more closely related to cheetahs. And while pumas are often found in mountains, they're just as at home in the lowlands, dense forests, treeless pampers, or deserts.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E04 - The Secret Lives of Lions
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Lions differ from all other cats in that they are highly social, forming prides of up to 35 animals. There are now thought to be fewer than 15,000 lions remaining in Kenya's Masai Mara, a drop of 75% in 50 years.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E06 - The Secret Lives of Jaguars
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. The first jaguar scientists struggled to go anywhere near their subjects. But times have changed. There are now a couple of places in the world where seeing a wild jaguar is a possibility rather than a dream.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E07 - The Secret Lives of Cheetahs
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Cheetahs are not your standard big cats, they differ from the others in many ways. First, cheetahs are daytime hunters with eyesight optimized for open landscape and distant prey. Second, They're possibly the fastest land animals that have ever lived.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Big Cats - S01:E05 - The Secret Lives of Leopards
programme.desc: Big cat populations are shrinking fast, but now we have the means to view them in more detail than ever. Like most big cats, the leopard is a master of secrecy. It's one of the hardest of all big cats to see, let alone observe. This is mainly because leopards need absolute invisibility to hunt. This is why they're such good climbers and why they evolved to be so incredibly secretive.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E03 - Tiger Shark
programme.desc: Ever wondered how a tiger shark hunts and feeds on its prey? Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E02 - Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E66 - Secrets Of A Dog's Nose
programme.desc: A dog's sense of smell can do amazing things. Dogs can help humans sniff out all kinds of things that improve our lives, explosives, missing persons, illegal drugs. Now the latest research is revealing that dogs can detect disease, even cancer.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E03 - Biggest
programme.desc: The Biggest? An Elephant? A Giraffe? A Hippopotamus? Or the humpback whale which is three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighs more than a dozen hippos. But which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E61 - Noahs Ark for the Humans
programme.desc: Our bodies are habitats for bacteria, and many of the microbes are beneficial to us. Scientists believe that within a few decades many useful microbes will have disappeared … so they want to create a vault for Human Microbiota like a Noah's Ark for the future of the human species.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E83 - The Great Seaweed Invasion
programme.desc: A giant mass of floating seaweed is invading popular beaches in the US and Caribbean!

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E92 - Superpredators
programme.desc: For thousands—or even millions—of years, they ruled the food chain. And they still fascinate us. Creatures synonymous with the hunt: Saber Teeth, Mega Jaws, even a Tyrant King. How did they win evolution’s race—and what brought their reign to an end?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E49 - Flight of the Dragon Mission Update
programme.desc: Witness this historic flight, from the first manned launch from the US in nearly a decade to the first splashdown attempt since the Apollo era.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E69 - Voyage to Venus
programme.desc: For the first time in decades, NASA is sending two new missions to Venus designed to study and explore the planet’s atmosphere and earth-like composition. Together, DAVINCI and VERITAS will provide a new, 360º view of Venus -- its history, and perhaps a window into Earth’s past as well.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E75 - Artemis First Launch
programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E94 - Artemis II Ready for the Moon
programme.desc: Explore the rockets, landers, vehicles, and space capsule paving the way for future Artemis missions to the lunar surface. And meet the engineers—and the machines—behind NASA's Commercial Lander Payload Services (CLPS) missions, which are revolutionizing humanity’s relationship with the Moon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E02 - Getting UpThere
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system. Ironically it's one of the few exploits Mankind undertakes that doesn't occur in nature.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E04 - Shore to Shore
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E05 - Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: As the latest successes and failures come and go Mars continues to give up her secrets. Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars. As we prepare to land humans on the red planet, getting there is one thing; staying long term is another, can we really conquor this planet?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E06 - Emissaries
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space. We humans cannot yet travel that sort of distance, however w e can and do send our robots and probes in our place; and the results are astounding.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E780 - Voyage Into The Sun Extended Version
programme.desc: For the first time in history, NASA’s Parker Solar Probe has pierced the Sun’s corona and is orbiting above its surface. Scientists have a front-row seat to better understand the sun and predict huge solar eruptions that can cause serious damage when they hit Earth.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E63 - First Human Link
programme.desc: 65 million years ago, an immense space rock slammed into Earth, creating the equivalent of nuclear winter, killing all of the dinosaurs. Now, a team of scientists believes there was a witness to the catastrophe …a survivor that walked alongside T-rex … and that also allowed humans to be here today.

programme.title: Catfish Murder
programme.desc: Doing her best to balance a successful career with family life, a single mom's world spirals out of control when her shy teenage son is arrested for the murder of a young woman from the same high school.

programme.title: Three Dates to Forever
programme.desc: Maddie Mckenzie is a hard-working presenter whose drive and talent has made her a popular radio host. John Reed is a carefree tech entrepreneur who's more interested in hosting parties. The two couldn't be more different.

programme.title: Falling for the Competition
programme.desc: Molly runs the local mom's group and this year they're entering the prestigious Modern Parenting Group of the Year Contest. When a new to town dad, Ashley, sets up a rival dad's group, their competitive natures cause competition in town.

programme.title: Dare to Say Yes

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E36 - Eric Cantona, Marta, Shinji Kagawa
programme.desc: Eric Cantona battled his own demons and teammates to become one of the best football players of the 90s, Marta took on prejudice and unequal pay to win a better place for women in world football, and Shiji Kagawa scored his way from Japan’s second division to reach the glamour of Manchester United.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E35 - Amanda Nunes, Conor McGregor
programme.desc: Amanda Nunes beat every single women’s champion in her divisions’ history to become the greatest female fighter ever. Conor McGregor took over the world’s biggest fight promotion in only a few brief years before crossing over to boxing to face the greatest boxer of all time in the biggest fight in history.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E34 - Fanny Blankers-Koen, Carl Lewis, Mia Hamm, Babe Didrikson
programme.desc: Fanny Blankers Koen didn’t let war or children stop her from winning a record gold medal haul, Carl Lewis matched a fifty year old Olympic record and then surpassed it, Mia Hamm brought US soccer from a marginal curiosity to the front of the Olympic stage, and Babe Zaharias became the best at everything when she was expected to be nothing at all.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E26 - Jose Mourinho, Bert Trautmann
programme.desc: This time on Against the Odds . . . the Special One, Jose Mourinho, who has managed many of the best clubs in football and won trophies wherever he’s gone, and one of Manchester City’s all-time greats, goalkeeper Bert Trautmann, and his courageous performance in the 1956 FA Cup Final.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E15 - Ayrton Senna, Alain Prost
programme.desc: They were the key players in a golden era of Formula One, the fascinatingly flawed Brazilian genius Ayrton Senna and his great rival, the meticulous Frenchman Alain Prost.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E22 - Johan Cruyff, Neymar
programme.desc: On this episode of Against the Odds we salute two of the most mercurial footballers the game has even known, the era-defining Johan Cruyff and Brazil superstar Neymar.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E30 - Leicester City FC, US Women’s National Soccer Team, Iceland
programme.desc: Leicester City were almost relegated in their first year back in England’s Premier League, the next year they won the entire competition. Megan Rapinoe and the US Women’s National Soccer Team took on prominent social issues while taking on the world’s best teams. Iceland were the smallest county to ever qualify for a major finals and ended up beating one of the giants of international football.

programme.title: Against the Odds - S01:E13 - Christiano Ronaldo, Zinedine Zidane, Eusebio
programme.desc: In this episode of Against the Odds, we look at the brilliant career of Ronaldo, perhaps the only Brazilian footballer to rival Pele; we examine Zinedine Zidane as a player and a manager who reached the top in both fields; and we pay tribute to 1960s legend Eusebio.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football’s Greatest Stage
programme.desc: A World Cup hero for West Germany, Franz Beckenbauer is enshrined in his country’s football folklore. A captain turned coach, Dunga inspired Brazil to glory in 1994, but came up heartbreakingly short in 2014. And Gordon Banks - who kept it clean for England on the way to greatness in 1966. That’s this week, on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E01 - Platini, Pele
programme.desc: Beauty is a defining characteristic on football’s greatest stage, certainly present in the careers of France’s Michel Platini and Italy’s Paolo Maldini. There was an element of the beautiful and the ugly for Brazilian coach Luiz Felipe Scolari. Pelé speaks for himself, but he had special sidekicks, too. And Germany’s goalkeeper Sepp Maier was the man in 1974, on Football’s Greatest Stage.

programme.desc: From a Dutch footballing legend who made his name at the World Cup, to the greats of the game who never set foot at the world’s biggest tournament. While the World Cup is revered by all who grace its stage, France self-destructed in 2010 in a manner unimaginable. And while he may have never won a World Cup, Chile’s Claudio Bravo made his nation proud on the Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E11 - World Cup 2014, Lahm, Beckenbauer, Germany, Bayern Munich, Guardiola
programme.desc: The quiet, unassuming character of Germany’s Philipp Lahm - one of the best Germany has seen. The 1998 World Cup in France - one with some of the best storylines. Paraguayan goalkeeper José Luis Chilavert didn’t shy away from creating his own legacy. Whether is big a footprint as Alf Ramsey, or as small as Paul the Octopus, it all happened on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: When people think of Portuguese football stars, it always seems to be Cristiano Ronaldo. But what about Eusébio? He was a World Cup star. Then there was the brilliant Italian Brains Trust of Vittorio Pozzo and Giuseppe Meazza. Can football survive without its stars? Brazil certainly didn’t cope without Neymar in 2014. So many storylines - on football’s greatest stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E05 - Pelé, Stockholm, Sweden, Eisenhower, The Beatles, World Cup 1958
programme.desc: The story of Pelé taking the World Cup by the scruff of the neck at the age of 17 is legend. And we all know what we went on to do after that. On the cusp of reunification, West Germany triumphed in 1990, while a couple of French legends helped their nation to the peak of World Cup glory in 1998. It’s all in this installment of Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: A ultimate story of commitment, Gerd Müller was a footballer for the people. Marcello Lippi - tasked with lifting Italy’s fortunes, delivers the Azzurri a famous victory in 2006. German keeper Oliver Kahn played hero and villain in 2002, but we have to return to 1966 to witness true heroics on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E08 - : Iniesta, Spain, World Cup 2010, Enrique, Barcelona, Tiki-taka
programme.desc: The World Cup is full of heart-rending stories, but not many pull at the heart strings like that of Spain’s Andrés Iniesta and Xavi. Dino Zoff, the man who inspired Italy to victory in 1982 is another great tale. Then there’s the fun and games of Vuvuzelas, Mexican Waves and WAGS. There’s much to discuss on Football’s Greatest Stage

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E12 - Zidane, Materazzi, World Cup 2006, Jacques Chirac, Czech Republic, Zizou
programme.desc: As we traverse the history of the World Cup, we revisit the wizard that was France’s Zinedine Zidane, and look back on Brazil’s Cafu, whose destiny on the world stage seemed preordained. For Northern Ireland’s Harry Gregg, his footprint was much more profound. And then there was Guus Hiddink - the brains behind South Korea’s inspired run on home soil, on Football’s Greatest Stage.
